items: Exam questions frequently test the proponent of the hotspot concept (Norman Myers).
Always identify habitat loss as the single largest contributor to species extinction.
Note for UPSC/State PSC exams: The current ongoing mass extinction is the 6th in Earth's history.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Biodiversity operates across three hierarchical levels: genetic, species, and ecosystem.
Norman Myers proposed the original concept of biodiversity hotspots.
Habitat loss is recognized globally as the primary cause of extinction.
Tropical regions exhibit the maximum concentration of biodiversity.
India is officially designated as a mega-diverse nation.
Earth is currently experiencing its sixth mass extinction event.
